editorial:
Eight medical students head to a snowy cabin in Norway for a weekend break, but their trip turns into a bloody fight for survival when zombie Nazi soldiers crawl out of the mountains. The movie mixes silly jokes with gory action, so you get laughs and shocks in equal measure. The group feels like real friends, and their panic makes the danger feel fun instead of too heavy. If you like horror that does not take itself too seriously, this one delivers a wild ride from the first attack to the last stand.

The action is fast, the makeup is gross in a good way, and the snowy setting gives every chase a sharp edge. It can feel a little thin on story, and some jokes land better than others, but the energy rarely drops. Fans of splatter comedy will have a blast, while viewers who dislike gore should skip it. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the surviving students try to escape the mountain after killing many zombie Nazis, but the undead keep coming. One student gets bitten and turns, forcing his friends to fight him. Another survivor reaches a car and drives away, only to discover a zombie hiding in the back seat. The movie ends with the car crashing and the last survivor likely doomed, leaving the Nazi zombies still roaming the snowy mountains.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves splatter comedy and wild zombie action.
